description: A6.4: the W9 q-Borel function DERIVED. The balanced-binomial inversion collapses the transform to the exact cancellation-free formula (−1)ⁿT̂_n = (q̃;q̃)_n²·Σ_k q̃^{k(n+1)}[n,k]_{q̃} (gated vs the direct route at dps 500), giving: the pole residue c∞ = (q̃;q̃)_∞² in closed form (the A6.3 Aitken plateau derived); the transient ratio exactly q̃ = 1/q₀ (the A6.3 0.90086 observation derived); and the POLE LADDER ĝ ~ poles at w = −q₀ᵏ (k = 1 rung located by Padé after exact pole subtraction). θ-Laplace re-run with the exact pole split: regularized D_odd vs the g3 median value, with the new pipeline's honest band. auditOnly; no c_k wired; no fit — every constant is derived.

data.verdict: THE W9 BOREL FUNCTION IS DERIVED: exact formula (★) (gate 1.1e-497), residue c∞ = (q̃;q̃)_∞² = 1.23076604e-12, transient ratio q̃, pole ladder at w = −q₀ᵏ (k=1 located, rel 4.6e-11). The regularized D_odd = -0.00757940374349 agrees with the g3 median (4.5e-12); the A6.3 precision caveat resolves — the pole term is now explicit, and the scheme band on the regular part is 1.1e-10. auditOnly.
